_comment: Test plan (user 2026-10-25: tests are built alongside the mod). Each feature needs at least `min` DIFFERENT in-game tests passing whose id starts with `prefix` (SCOPE-TEST pass <id>). A new feature = a new line here in the same change (the release tester checks it, and refuses a line removed or a min lowered since the last release). Never lower a min or remove a line to get a push through. Client-only add-on, every Fabric / Forge / NeoForge version in versions/. Each test compares Turbo against plain Litematica in the same game where it can.

features.what: every patch applies on every version
multithreaded chunk builds give exactly the same schematic geometry as Litematica alone
chunks next to the player rebuilt in the background, same result
smooth placement moving: shown moved, rebuilt once stopped, swapped in one frame, same final result
Turbo tab: every setting saves, loads and applies right away
a broken patch switches Turbo off for the session with a chat message, no crash, Litematica unchanged
